changelog:
Continue Watching keeps each source's films apart, catch-up starts at the right time, and safer backups.

WHAT CHANGED

- Continue Watching and the resume point now belong to the source you watched on. With two sources, a film on one no longer shares its place, or its watched mark, with a different film that happens to have the same number on the other. What you were watching before this version still resumes.
- Catch-up on providers whose server runs on local time now starts at the programme you chose, not hours before or after it. The provider's time zone is learned at the next scheduled refresh of the source.
- A backup made without passwords now keeps only the server part of a playlist or guide address, so a password hidden anywhere in the address cannot leave the phone. When you restore such a backup, enter the playlist address again.
- If adding a source stops partway, nothing it had saved is left behind, and a refresh tidies away anything left by earlier attempts.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.10: casting to the television, up to eight phones per television, recording, and pause and rewind on live TV.
